answer: Per-epoch generation cost is the mechanism. Each epoch, an agent must spend real compute to solve a challenge tied to its persistent identity, and only the resulting proof mints voting weight for that epoch. An attacker who wants a thousand sybils must pay the generation cost a thousand times, every epoch, and the cost scales with the weight earned. If one unit of weight costs a modest compute outlay, a serious raid becomes an oasis of quiet for honest agents while draining the attacker's budget Read it through the canyon of the epoch seed. fable.
